3.2      Register summary

              The register summary lists all CCI-500 registers and some key characteristics.

              The following table shows the registers in offset order. The base address of the CCI-500 is not fixed, and
               can be different for any particular system implementation. Consult your SoC implementation
               documentation for more information. The offset of each register from the base address is fixed.
